text:
A lorry of mass 4000kg is travelling at a speed of 4.0m/s.
A car has a mass of 1000kg. The kinetic energy of the car is equal to the kinetic energy of the
lorry.
What is the speed of the car?
A
2.0m/s
B
4.0m/s
C
8.0m/s
D
16.0m/s
subject: Physics
